```yaml
name: Infra Health Monitoring & Auto-Remediation

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/60 * * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  infraHealthCheck:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run Redis health check
        run: bash scripts/redis-health.sh

      - name: Run PostgreSQL health check
        run: psql -c "SELECT 1"

      - name: Create OpsGenie alert
        run: |
          curl -X POST \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d '{"message": "Infra issue detected", "alias": "infra-issue"}' \
            https://api.opsgenie.com/v2/alerts

      - name: Trigger auto-remediation for P1 issues
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}
        run: echo "Triggering auto-remediation for P1 issues"

  publicHealthEndpoint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Start server
        run: npm start &
        id: server

      - name: Check health endpoint
        run: |
          sleep 10
          curl -I http://localhost:3000/api/status/health | grep HTTP/1.1

  infra-auto-remediation:
    needs: [infraHealthCheck]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Investigate P1 alerts
        run: echo "Investigating P1 alerts"

      - name: Post findings to Discord
        run: echo "Posting findings to Discord"

      - name: Create GH issue
        run: echo "Creating GH issue"
```
